name: net_session_browser_dialog_on_timer
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::OnTimer refreshes the enumerated session list and then dispatches MFC default message handling. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
CWnd::Default is treated as an MFC provider boundary; the smoke patches the smoke process MFC42 ordinal 2379 import and restores it before return.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41b660 validates the message-map handler ABI with one stack argument, a call to NetSessionBrowserDialog::RefreshSessionList on this, a subsequent call to MFC CWnd::Default on the same this pointer, ignored return value, and ret 4 cleanup.
The native smoke patches RefreshSessionList and MFC42 CWnd::Default ordinal 2379, then verifies OnTimer calls both once on the dialog instance.
